notes:
Opportunity summary: Halcyon is a UK-headquartered fintech offering portfolio analytics and internal research tools to asset management teams. Primary pain: existing search (self-hosted Elastic + ad-hoc vector store) is inconsistent across regions — UK users see 120-300ms tail for search; they need sub-50ms p95 for production dashboards and sub-150ms end-to-end for a two-stage dense-re-rank flow. Index scale: target initial corpus ~10M documents, with aggressive nearline updates (200k new/updated docs/day). Expect vector index to reach ~120M vectors after enrichment (per-chunk embeddings). They are cost-sensitive; finance asked for modeled cost per query (embedding + ANN retrieval + lightweight transformer rerank).

Technical preferences & constraints: prefer EU/UK data residency (must keep primary index and KMS keys in EU/UK), VPC connectivity to customer network for audit and egress control, option to move to on-prem air-gapped environment for regulated datasets. Model choices: open Llama-family / quantized candidates for reranker, and hosted embedding model that can be pinned to a vetted runtime. Key requirements: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs with tamper-evidence, KMS integration for key separation, retention & legal hold capabilities.

POC ask: Redwood to run a 2-week POC with dedicated EU nodes (preference: UK-south + eu-west failover). POC tests: 1) index 10M doc snapshot and measure index build time and incremental update latency; 2) measure retrieval p95 and rerank 99 across 100k synthetic queries; 3) run chaos routing test (simulate eu-west outage and verify automatic failover to UK-south within 30s); 4) show per-token/per-query cost breakdown in Console.

Quotes & call notes: "We cannot risk longer tails during market hours — 50ms p95 is table stakes for dashboards" — CTO (Martin O'Connell). Product lead: "If Redwood can show stable per-query cost under our target with routing controls, we can move to a 12-month Dedicated contract".

Commercial notes: procurement timeline ~May 2026. Prefers reserved capacity for predictable throughput but wants fallback to hosted for burst. Key negotiation anchors: regional data residency guarantees, SLA for failover, and clear pricing on incremental index size.

Next steps (detailed): schedule security questionnaire handoff (Hannah + Halcyon infosec), deliver POC plan and cost-model spreadsheet (Miguel), confirm snapshot transfer mechanism and KMS provisioning, legal to draft data processing addendum for UK/EU residency.
